findings.evidence: Mathlib has unconditional `natDegree_ΨSq_le` at `DivisionPolynomial/Degree.lean:345`, while `ΨSq_zero` and `Φ_zero` are at `DivisionPolynomial/Basic.lean:250,363`; the PR instead invokes the stronger `natDegree_ΨSq hn` at line 79 solely to obtain an equality where the upper bound suffices.
findings.fix: Generalize monicity to arbitrary `n` (with only `Nontrivial R`, or handle the subsingleton case), using `W.natDegree_ΨSq_le n` when `n ≠ 0` and `Φ_zero`/`ΨSq_zero` when `n = 0`; then remove `hn` and `NoZeroDivisors R` from the integrality theorem.
findings.issue: `monic_Φ_sub_C_mul_ΨSq` and consequently `isInteger_of_mul_eval_ΨSq_eq_eval_Φ` unnecessarily require `[NoZeroDivisors R]` and `(n : R) ≠ 0`; monicity also holds when the characteristic divides `n`, and for `n = 0`.

summary: The main results are unnecessarily restricted by both `NoZeroDivisors R` and `(n : R) ≠ 0`; the available degree bound supports the natural characteristic-independent statement.
